# WordPress.com

> > WordPress.com is a complete website building and hosting platform offering ecommerce solutions, professional services, and enterprise-grade infrastructure powered by WordPress, WooCommerce, and WordPress VIP.

WordPress.com provides a comprehensive suite of tools for creating websites, from personal blogs to enterprise-level ecommerce stores. The platform integrates WooCommerce for online retail, WordPress Studio for creative workflows, and WordPress VIP for high-performance enterprise hosting, alongside Google Apps integration for productivity.

## Key Topics

- WordPress
- WordPress.com
- WooCommerce
- WordPress Studio
- WordPress VIP
- Ecommerce
- Online Store Builder
- Website Builder
- Commerce Platform

- Web Hosting
- Enterprise Solutions

## Ecommerce & Online Stores

- [Ecommerce Website Builder | Build Online Stores with WordPress](https://wordpress.com/ecommerce): WordPress.com ecommerce solution with WooCommerce for online stores
